name: Belaras Quill
description: During your turn, ^recover^ up to one Tome item.

name: Ice Shiv
description: During your melee attack ability, @wfh-ice-consume@ to add $wfh-pierce$ 3 to one attack.

name: Black Box
description: During yor turn, discard two cards from your hand to perform: ^fh-heal^ 6 ~!self!~

name: Lightning Rod
description: After ordering of initiative, all monsters consider you to be first in initiative order when determining focus this round. ^eot^

name: Armor of Empathy
description: After the next three attacks targeting you, flip this card over.
backDescription: During your turn, perform ^fh-heal^ 3 ~!^target^ 1 ally, ^fh-range^ 3, $wfh-bless$!~ then flip this card over.

name: Algox Carving
description: During your melee attack ability, @wfh-earth-consume@ to add +1 ^attack^ to one attack and flip this card over.
backDescription: During your melee attack ability, @wfh-air-consume@ to add $wfh-push$ 2 to one attack and flip this card over.

name: Unfettered Arm
description: During your attack ability, double the numerical value of the next attack modifier card you draw. ^modifier_2x_circle^ and ^modifier_no_damage^ modifier cards are unaffected.

name: Data Drive
description: When you short rest, place half (rounded down) of your discard pile on this item, lose of the remaining cards randomly as normal, then draw the cards on this item.

name: Extendable Pole
description: During your turn, open one unlocked door while within ^fh-range^ 2.

name: Exquisite Map
description: During your turn grant one ally within ^fh-range^ 3: ^fh-move^ 3

name: Examination Glass
description: After you draw one loot card, draw one additional card, keep one, and place the other on either the top or bottom of the loot deck.

name: Skinning Knife
description: When you gain a loot token, gain 3 `hide` instead of drawing a loot card.

name: Orchid Wand
description: During your turn lose 1 morale to perform: $wfh-bless$ ~!^target^ all allies and self!~

name: Dead Raven

name: Cracked Mirror

name: Mesmerizing Seashell
description: During your turn, choose one of six directions. You and all figures within ^fh-range^ 2 are forced to simultaneously move 2 hexes in the chosen direction.

name: Cracked Idol
description: When you would become exhausted from suffering ^damage^, set your hit point value to 1 instead.

name: Eye of the Storm

name: Demons Gem

name: Shimmering Powder

name: Lucky Dice
description: During your attack ability, treat the next three attack modifier cards you draw as rolling

description: This item cannot be sold and must be brought into and used every scenario. At the start of the scenario perform: $wfh-curse$, $wfh-bless$ ~!self!~

name: Ember Energy Source

name: Trainers Net
description: During your turn, capture an adjacent enemy whose hit point value is 1 or 2.

name: Wanderer's Club
description: During your attack ability, move one character token on one of your persistent abilities backward one slot and add +X ^attack^ to one attack, where X is the number of active persistent abilities.

name: Recalibration Trigger
description: During our turn, perform one of the two following abilities: Lose one card from your hand to gain 3 ^fh-hourglass^. ~@-2 ^fh-hourglass^ : ^recover^ up to two of your discarded cards@~

name: Spear of Justice
description: During your turn perform: ^attack^ 2 ~!^fh-range^ 3!~. All your banners are treated as additionally occupying the hex of the attack target of their bonuses and that hex is treated as occupied by an ally this round. ^eot^

name: Soul Urn
description: Place one ^fh-shadow^ in an adjacent hex. @wfh-dark@

name: Black Earth Codex
description: On the next three deaths of any of your summons,

name: Mask of Duality
description: During your ranged attack ability while in ^fh-geminate-right^, gain advantage for one attack, then flip this card over.
backDescription: When an enemy performs an attack targeting you while you are in ^fh-geminate-left^, the attacker gains disadvantage, then flip this card over.

name: Ancestral Blade
description: During your turn, activate all your ^fh-astral^ as if you just performed a ^fh-astral^ action.

name: Mountain's Heart
description: During your turn, you may create either one 1-hex obstacle or hazardous terrain tile in an empty tile within ^fh-range^ 2.

name: Sonorous Shard
description: Gain 3 ^fh-shards^

name: Sly Camouflage
description: When you create a trap, place a character token on it.  Monsters do not treat the trap as negative. Remove the token when you ^recover^ this item. ^ongoing^

name: Storm Carving
description: During an attack ability you grant an ally, add $wfh-push$ 2 to one of their attacks, then flip this card over.
backDescription: During your attack ability you, add $wfh-pull$ 2 to one attack, then flip this card over.

name: Freezing Orb
description: During your attack ability, add $wfh-brittle$ to one attack and create one 1-hex icy terrain tile in the featureless hex occupied by the target.

name: Energized Module
description: Remove all damage and negative conditions from one of your summons, then ^fh-prism^ to that summon.

name: Exhaust Boots
description: During your move ability, when you have ^fh-meter-yellow^ or ^fh-meter-red^, add +1 ^fh-move^, then flip this card over at the end of your turn.
backDescription: During your turn when you have ^fh-meter-blue^, perform: $wfh-muddle$ ~!^fh-range^ 1!~ then flip this card over at the end of your turn.

name: Warlords Skull
description: Whenever you gain $wfh-invisible$ or perform a teleport ability while you have $wfh-invisible$, after the ability perform: $wfh-muddle$ ~!^fh-range^ 1!~

name: Spiraled Medallion
